svg.title: Speed against v0.6.1, every timed case
svg.desc: Timing set 2026-10-20-against-v0.6.1: v0.6.1 against main at 876247f, the first v0.7 speed package. 133 timed cases in 23 timing examples, each drawn as the v0.6.1 median time divided by the new one on a log scale centred at 1, over the band of its A/A noise. 103 are faster beyond their A/A band, 18 slower beyond it (SHA-256 alone at 0.28 and 0.39) and 12 inside it. 22 of 23 timed examples printed the same output digest in all three trees. speed_top1_many has only a manifest: its API does not exist in v0.6.1, so the example does not build there. speed_tree_gates prints DIFFERENT_OUTPUT because it counts the files of the tree it runs in, and the two trees differ. Machine: AMD Ryzen AI 9 HX 370, 24 hardware threads, 94 GiB RAM, Linux 6.17; load average 2.7 at the start, 12.6 to 19.4 at the end, from other work on the machine; not pinned to cores. Ratios of different cases are not comparable with each other; the output digests, not the timings, are the claim.
svg.text: SPEED · v0.6.1 AGAINST main AT 876247f · SET 2026-10-20-against-v0.6.1
133 timed cases in 23 timing examples: v0.6.1 time divided by the new time
A, A2: two checkouts of v0.6.1 · B: main at 876247f, the first v0.7 speed package · medians of 9 to 27 runs per case
Machine: AMD Ryzen AI 9 HX 370, 24 hardware threads, 94 GiB RAM, Linux 6.17 · not pinned to cores
Load: load average 2.7 at the start, 12.6 to 19.4 at the end, from other work on the machine
same output digest in A, A2 and B: 22 of 23
no timing: the example does not build in v0.6.1

g.text: 27 runs per case · output digests differ · note 2

svg.text: Note 1 · speed_top1_many has only a manifest: its API does not exist in v0.6.1, so the example does not build there.
Note 2 · speed_tree_gates prints DIFFERENT_OUTPUT because it counts the files of the tree it runs in, and the two trees differ.
The machine was loaded and the runs were not pinned to cores, so each grey band, one A/A ratio of two copies of v0.6.1, is the noise to read its
bar against: a single sample of that noise, not a confidence interval. A case counts as faster or slower only beyond its band. Bars of different
cases are not comparable with each other: each times its own work. The output digests, not the timings, are the claim.
